field_descriptions.applicable_location: The location in which the status applies.
field_descriptions.cost_category: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.
field_descriptions.cost_currency: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.
field_descriptions.cost_origin: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.
field_descriptions.cost_per_unit: The cost per unit of the drug.
field_descriptions.drug_unit: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
